title: Fetch the Waves Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Nestled into a peaceful, wooded lot on a private road in Magnolia Cottages by the Sea off 30A, Fetch the Waves is your dog-friendly beach home for up to 9 guests. You're just 2 doors down from the community pool and just 5 minutes to the beach.
description_expanded: **SNOWBIRD PROMOTION- Save 50% PER NIGHT January and February for monthly stays!** HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - ACCESS TO THE PUBLIC WIDE BEACH (OR PRIVATE FOR MAIN TOWNS) WITH NO RESTRICTIONS. - .2 mi/ 5 minutes walking from the beach - 2 Adult sized beach cruisers included - Walking/biking distance to shops, playgrounds, and restaurants - Spacious outdoor screened in patio with sitting area - Private driveway parking - Fully stocked kitchen - Access to community pool - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ONS: -Vacation Cancellation Protection- Allows cancellation for any reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies refunded ($125 fee applies at booking) Nestled into a peaceful, wooded lot on a private road in Magnolia Cottages by the Sea off 30A, Fetch the Waves is your dog-friendly beach home for up to 9 guests. You're just 2 doors down from the community pool and just 5 minutes to the beach. Fetch The Waves has 3 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms and guests enjoy all the extra free goodies: a beach wagon, 6 beach chairs and 2 umbrellas. The welcoming screened-in front porch is the highlight of the home with plenty of comfortable seating and colorful cushions. This porch is the ultimate hang-out for the whole family! The home features warm hardwood floors, a large seating area and a 60” 4K Smart TV for the whole group to gather around and relax after a hard day of vacationing! The dining area features seating for 6 and the kitchen bar area adds 3 more seats. The kitchen is fully-equipped for the home chef in your group, with plenty of counter space. The washer and dryer are tucked away in a closet off of the kitchen. 30A & SEACREST Ready to explore? The Big Chill is only 1.5 miles to the west on 30A with shopping, restaurants and family entertainment. Alys Beach and Rosemary is 2 miles to the East along 30A. Along with the area's sugar white beaches and emerald green waters, the 30A corridor offers everything for everyone. Walk, bike or run along the Timpoochee Trail, paddle board on Western Lake among the umbrella pines, explore one of 3 state parks, or simply peruse the nearby communities of Seaside, Prominence, Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach. ACCOMMODATIONS: (sleeps 9) First Floor: Bedroom 1 - King bed, 43" 4K Smart TV. Private bathroom with tub/shower combo. Bedroom 2 - Twin-over-full bunk plus twin-over-twin bunk, 50" Smart TV, Pack 'n Play, shared hallway bathroom with shower. Second Floor: Bedroom 3 - King bed, 60" 4K Smart TV, private balcony. Private bathroom with dual sinks and tub/shower combo. ** Parking for 2 cars. ** Sandpiper cannot guarantee/service owner-provided amenities such as beach chairs, beach toys, etc. ** Dog Friendly: If bringing a pet, an additional $150 non-refundable pet fee will be added to your booking per dog. Please contact us if you are bringing a dog. A maximum of 2 dogs is allowed at a maximum of 30 lbs. FREE WIFI

Amenities: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF
